claim: How many calories do y'all eat in a day to lose weight? - Reddit
summary: You want to lose weight so go on a deficit. Start off on maintenance for 2 weeks then drop 200 calories for a week then extra 200 for a week then extra 200 for a week to have a 600 calorie deficit. 21M, 6’4, 98kg. I eat 3600 calories a day now for my maintenance then when on a cut I’ll drop to 2200.
